messages:
maria: quick check — console delegation sampling is showing a lot of 'unknown_origin' in the quota dashboard for proxied requests. spotted during a canary. anyone seen this?

sam: saw it Friday. short version: auth-proxy strips X-Origin-Project before re-signing, and our quota/tagging path depends on that header. when it's missing telemetry falls back to token introspect which gets sampled out under load.

leo: ugh. that will break per-route cost insights for canaries. do we have any fallback attribution rules?

sam: fallback is token introspect then null. introspect QPS is the bottleneck. traces we have are sparse so dashboard looks like Unknown a lot.

ali: idea — add a small introspect cache keyed on token signature with TTL ~60s, optimized for high hit-rate bursts. use only for telemetry attribution, not enforcement. reduces introspect QPS and increases attribution coverage.

maria: sounds promising. console needs higher fidelity for rollouts; if we can show better attribution it'll help threshold decisions.

leo: UX request — expose an "attribution_confidence" field in the dashboard (high/medium/low) and an origin_source enum (header|introspect|inferred|unknown). That way PMs know when to trust numbers.

sam: implementation sketch: (1) stop stripping X-Origin-Project in proxy re-sign path (2) add token introspect cache library (3) emit telemetry tags: auth.origin_source and auth.attribution_confidence.

ali: important: do NOT use cache results for quota enforcement. stale cached introspects could route quota to wrong project. telemetry-only usage avoids billing issues. enforcement stays strict: require live introspect or pre-bound SA->project mapping.

maria: agreed. telemetry-only cache + enforcement strict path. we should also add diffing alerts when attribution confidence drops for an active canary.

console-bot: deploy queued: auth-proxy keep-origin header change -> canary us-west-2 at 01:00 UTC. build/9876

sam: I'll open PR for the cache (lib + metrics). metrics planned: auth.introspect.cache_hit, auth.introspect.cache_miss, auth.origin.confidence_dist.

leo: i'll add UX mockups for the confidence indicator and tooltip explaining "why unknown". will link in the PR.

ali: i'll run a staging load test (10k RPS) to measure introspect QPS and cache effectiveness, plus run billing simulation to confirm enforcement path isn't impacted.

maria: tagging @security for visibility on token caching and TTL choices.

security: noted. we'll review TTL, cache eviction policy, and ensure no sensitive token material is logged. require KMS-backed key handling if any token material is persisted.

maria: created task INF-7731 to track end-to-end (proxy change, cache lib, telemetry schema, console UX, security review, canary). aiming for canary demo next Tue.

sam: ack, PR incoming.

ali: ack, i'll post load test results back here.

maria: thanks all — keeping this thread for followups.
